title: microcoder local_run replay tests fail on main
body: Reported by the #10254 and #10281 agents: two `microcoder` `local_run` tests (a replay test among them) fail on clean origin/main, along with `recipe_class_eval` in coder-delegate. Identify each failing test, find whether it's a stale fixture/recording after recent changes (lean session 0fd51fe58f, prompt change, #10281 67d7c09e4b) or a real regression, and fix (re-record fixtures only if the new behavior is intended, and say why).
